decisions.reason: The resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component dosing and pumping know-how, so it can learn from construction-sector feedback and keep refining it in-house.
It rests on the same core plural-component knowledge as Product A, though the overlap between the two units keeps the risk of consolidating them moderately higher.
Automatic airless guns sit at the centre of the firm's spray expertise and in-house manufacturing, which gives it strong capacity to interpret results and improve the product.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory tied to the existing pumps and customer base, so field feedback is easy to absorb and the product is cheap to sustain.
The air-assisted airless line extends established spray technology to industrial coating customers, but a multi-model line may see some models pruned.

Digital electronics lie further from the firm's mechanical knowledge base and are harder to assimilate, but the data logger supports service and quality documentation for coating jobs, so the firm keeps it while it builds competence.
